items.title: For investors with long horizons and focus on underlying businesses: 5 mid- and small-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 34%
items.description: Here’s one thing to remember: Be very careful when you use fresh money to average down a stock because it has fallen. Averaging is not a strategy if the original investment thesis has weakened. In many cases, the habit of averaging only increases the size of the eventual loss. Fresh capital deserves fresh ideas.
